title_zh: Sonny Boy 与华丽的等候室

lines.en: label halloweenfive16:
scene poolparty1
: Gosh darn it. Where am I this time?
lines.zh: : 真是的。这次我是在哪儿？

lines.en: Greetings, Akira Arakawa. And welcome to the Oceanic Branch Office Waiting Room. It is here where you will await your appointment.
lines.zh: 你好，Akira Arakawa。欢迎来到海洋分所等候室。您将在此等候您的预约。

lines.en: : What appointment? I don’t remember making an appointment. The last thing I remember is NOTHING AT ALL.
lines.zh: : 什么预约？我不记得我约过。我记得的最后一件事是什么都没有。

lines.en: : Woah, weird. I’m pretty sure I just went through something seriously traumatic. And now it’s already gone?
lines.zh: : 哇，好怪。我很确定我刚刚经历了什么极其创伤的事。结果现在就没了？

lines.en: It isn’t uncommon for UNVALUABLE MEMORIES to be cleansed from our members and prospective members upon arrival at the waiting room.
lines.zh: 对于我们的会员和准会员来说，在抵达等候室时清除掉毫无价值的记忆并不罕见。

lines.en: It’s important to keep our facilities clean and free of viruses so that all of our guests have a relaxing time waiting for their recoordination.
lines.zh: 保持我们的设施清洁、无病毒，让所有客人在等待重新协调时都能放松，这一点很重要。

lines.en: And thanks to new technology from the Shiawase Group, we were able to spray away your impurities without any resistance at all.
lines.zh: 而且多亏了 Shiawase 集团的新技术，我们得以毫无阻力地把你的杂质冲洗干净。

lines.en: Don’t worry, though! Your unpleasant memories should come right back the moment your appointment concludes.
lines.zh: 不过别担心！您的不愉快记忆会在预约结束的那一刻立刻回来。

lines.en: : No, it’s okay. You can keep them.
lines.zh: : 不，没关系。你们留着吧。

lines.en: Unfortunately, we are unable to fit any additional dark-matter into our Box of Unpleasant Memories.
lines.zh: 很遗憾，我们的「不愉快记忆之盒」已经装不下任何额外的暗物质了。

lines.en: : Ugh. Fine. So what am I supposed to do then? Gather keys? Defeat enemies? Fill out magazine sweepstakes?
lines.zh: : 呃。好吧。那我该干什么？收集钥匙？打败敌人？填杂志抽奖券？

lines.en: This is a waiting room. You are supposed to wait.
lines.zh: 这里是等候室。你应该等候。

lines.en: : That’s it?
lines.zh: : 就这样？

lines.en: That’s it! Then, once your number is called, you’ll report to Robbie Receptionson to confirm your identity.
lines.zh: 就这样！然后，一旦叫到您的号码，您就去 Robbie Receptionson 那里确认身份。

lines.en: As soon as the check-in process is complete, you will be taken to your coordinator’s office and begin the interview process.
lines.zh: 登记流程一完成，您就会被带到协调员的办公室，开始面谈流程。

lines.en: : Okay. What’s my number?
lines.zh: : 好的。我的号码是多少？

lines.en: Please feel free to speak to any of the other guests or help yourself to some refreshments if you find yourself with an excess amount of time.
lines.zh: 如果您觉得时间充裕，请随意与其他客人交谈，或者自取一些点心。

lines.en: : Sure. But what’s my number?
lines.zh: : 行。可我的号码是多少？

lines.en: Additionally, the waiting room is currently doubling as a YMCA. Membership is not included in your recoordination appointment. Using the pool without a YMCA membership is prohibited.
lines.zh: 另外，本等候室目前同时兼作 YMCA。会员资格不包含在您的重新协调预约内。没有 YMCA 会员资格禁止使用泳池。

lines.en: : Please just tell me my number.
lines.zh: : 拜托直接告诉我我的号码。

lines.en: Good luck, Akira Arakawa! May your wait be as pleasant as it is dry.
lines.zh: 祝您好运，Akira Arakawa！愿您的等待既愉快又干燥。

lines.en: : Ugh. These silly bureaucratic facilities never function properly. How am I supposed to wait for my number to be called if I don’t even know what my number is?
lines.zh: : 唉。这些愚蠢的官僚机构从来没正常运转过。我连自己的号码是多少都不知道，要怎么等它叫号？

lines.en: : Oh well...I guess I’ll just have to hope they call out my name as well. But in the meantime, I suppose I should get acquainted with everyone.
lines.zh: : 算了……我想我只能指望他们连名字一起叫了。不过在此期间，我想我应该和大家认识一下。

lines.en: : It sounds like I might be here for a while.
lines.zh: : 听起来我也许要在这儿待上一阵子。
